name: Tomioka (Fukushima, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Tomioka town emblem in white: a ring of segments around a central disc, like a cog.
history: Municipal flag of Tomioka, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Tomioka town emblem — a ring of segments around a central disc, like a cog
